title: A viewer arranges their own Home rows, the same on every device
description: A viewer would choose and order the rows of their Home, including saved filters, and see the same on every device. PRODUCT.md promises a short Home and saved rules as collections (JS-327), not Home rows a viewer arranges.
bringBack: When stage 5 is split into tasks: evidence that viewers change Home (Octave's own measurement or the test installation's), weighed against a short Home that is the same for everyone.
notes: Saved filters as collections that keep themselves up to date are planned under JS-327.
